title: A bulk session activation must not resend faces that are already active
rule: When a UI action activates a selection for the session (A on several rows, a family row), send only the faces that are not active yet. fm-core treats an active face in the other mode as a mode switch and releases its permanent registration, so resending a permanently active face makes it session-only and it is gone after a restart. For a partly active family, read its faces fresh (getFamily) and send only the inactive ones; leave the family out when they cannot be read. Test it with a selection that mixes a permanent face and an inactive one and assert the permanent face stays permanent.
rationale: E6.8 (#81): pressing A on a mixed selection sent every row as one session activate, so fm-core switched permanently active fonts to session-only.
